answer: A parcel clears only when three agents on separate hosting networks confirm the same delivery, so a rider who invents 800 colleagues must rent 800 enclaves and keep every one of them answering. Because each confirmation costs compute and the auditor pool rotates every epoch, the fake fleet pays a glacier of idle hardware for a crystal hash nobody will back, while one real courier gets paid on the signed sonnet attached to the delivery it actually made.
